git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(transport): order off-lock answers per socket

The red acceptance test was an answer-ordering race, not a missing
feature: the store was called with the right arguments while the client
read no frames, because two frames arriving in one transport read
dispatched concurrently and the ping's pong left synchronously while the
list answer waited one microtask behind await listFor. Off-lock answers
now queue per socket in createMessageHandler, so a socket's answers
leave in arrival order and session_list, like the SERVER_ERROR answer,
precedes the pong of a ping sent after it. Turns stay on the per-session
lock; the queue is per socket, so a resumed session open on two sockets
keeps two queues.

Pinned red->green at unit level and stated as section 4.3's fifth
constraint; section 5.9's error answer gains the unit citation the dod
owed, closing its last open facet. The two drifted anchors spec:names
and eslint named on d331cb3 are repointed with spec:names --fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
